biography: Justin Senzer is a highly experienced Senior Real Estate Transaction Manager with a strong background in data center development and property development. He has 6 years of total property development experience, with 4 years specifically in data center development across EMEA. His expertise includes market strategy, site sourcing, acquisition, and entitlement and permitting processes. Justin has a proven track record of leading complex projects from origination to construction, including significant environmental remediation and strategic engagement with governmental bodies. He is adept at navigating international markets and has a keen interest in driving projects through the full development cycle. Justin is currently seeking a role with a stronger development focus and stability, given recent organizational changes and uncertainties in his current company.
